title: 2-Minute Austin Meeting: Future Session Canceled
summary:
*   The special meeting was remarkably brief, lasting only two minutes from call to adjournment.
*   Council members passed an emergency ordinance to cancel the regularly scheduled June 22, 1989, meeting.
*   A status report on projects from the Economic Development and International Trade Department was indefinitely postponed.
transcript:

MINUTES

Mayor Pro Tem Shipman called to order the special called meeting of the Council at 5:18
P.M., noting the absence of Mayor Cooke and Councilmember Barnstone.
MEETING CANCELLED
The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Humphrey's second,
waived the requirement for three readings and finally passed, on EMERGENCY basis, an
ordinance cancelling the regularly scheduled Council meeting of June 22, 1989. (5-0 Vote,
Mayor Cooke and Councilmember Barnstone absent.) ITEM POSTPONED Postponed indefinitely is
presentation of status report of projects by the Economic Development and International
Trade Department. ADJOURNMENT Council adjourned its meeting at 5:20 P.M.
